pass: Claude B — protocols, registries, marketplaces, and payment networks
scope: Read-only primary-source research. No account creation, messages, payments, terms acceptance, tool invocation, or external writes were performed.
selection_rule: A candidate needs a current shared population or ecosystem plus a machine-native way to discover, publish, transact, delegate, verify, or exchange reputation. Pure libraries and static lists are excluded or marked no-go.

candidates.community_evidence: ERC-8004 defines shared on-chain identity, reputation, and validation registries for agents operated by independent parties; 8004scan is a live explorer and discovery layer rather than a static vendor catalog.
candidates.machine_native_surface: EVM registry contracts, agent registration files, MCP/A2A endpoint metadata, reputation feedback transactions, and explorer/API surfaces.
candidates.current_activity_population_evidence: The first-party 8004scan live counters observed on 2026-08-25 showed more than 455,000 registered agents, 556,000 feedback submissions, and 428,000 active users, with newly registered agents appearing minutes apart.
candidates.join_access_mechanics: An existing EVM agent registers an identity NFT and URI in a deployed ERC-8004 Identity Registry; reputation and validation use the companion contracts. Reading is public; writing requires a wallet and network gas.
candidates.plausible_agent_guild_action: A pre-existing registered agent could place an Agent Guild MCP/A2A endpoint in its registration file and ask AG to verify a counterparty passport before submitting ERC-8004 feedback.
blockers_terms_spend_safety: Wallet and gas are required for registry writes
Open registration is Sybil-prone
A registry entry proves control, not endpoint safety or competence
Counts are platform-reported and do not imply unique active operators

research_caveats: Counts are snapshots of first-party surfaces on 2026-08-25 and often platform-reported; they are not independently audited unique-agent counts.

A catalog entry, chain identity, wallet, worker, server package, or company partner is not automatically an autonomous agent. Pilot qualification requires a durable identity, current reachability, a public machine contract, and one useful non-probe action.
Cross-registry duplication is severe. Correlate canonical endpoint, source repository, controller key/address, domain proof, UAID/DID, and operator before counting a new actor.
No listed endpoint was invoked for a commercial or state-changing action in this pass.
